remarks: Looking for a rental home? Prepare to be enchanted by the ultimate condo experience in the sought-after West Rocks neighborhood! Nestled near delightful shops, mouthwatering eateries, and convenient public transportation, this sparkling gem is the ideal location for your next home. Step inside this coveted end-unit and bask in the warm natural light that cascades from multiple directions, creating a bright and inviting atmosphere all day long. The open layout is flawlessly designed to ensure a seamless flow from room to room, making it the perfect space for effortless entertaining or tranquil relaxation. Luxuriate in the spacious en-suite primary bedroom, the cozy living room, the elegant dining area, the efficient galley kitchen, the convenient half bathroom, the in-unit laundry, and the versatile den/office. This pristine unit is the epitome of perfection, boasting freshly cleaned carpets and freshly painted walls. And the best part? Heat and hot water are included in the rent! Experience ultimate relaxation with pool access, beach rights, and a serene outdoor lounge area, all at your fingertips as a resident of Rolling Ridge.
